verdict.rationale: The evidence describes 01 as an open-source platform with a server ('brain') and several first-party clients (mobile, ESP32, desktop), plus profile-based customization. None of it documents an SDK or API that developers can use to embed device control in their own applications, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A client-server architecture and hardware 'custom integrations' guides are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented embedding SDK/API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed device control in my own application through a documented SDK or API
